influences.name: Solange
influences.context: Like Solange famously once said, do nothing without intention. A Seat at the Table is probably one of my favorite albums ever.

influences.name: Dev Hynes
influences.context: Dev of course worked on that, and whenever his music comes up—because it's always playing everywhere—I act like a proud auntie and have to tell him. What's so brilliant about what Dev does is at the end of the day, the song is a simple pop song, but it's fantastic songwriting with simple production.

influences.name: Black Sabbath
influences.context: They were the background of my youth in a way. Obviously I looked for something else. Probably partly because I'm black, I looked for somewhere where I felt I belonged a bit more. The Last Poets (a pioneering 1960s collective of African-American poets and musicians) and Gil Scott-Heron were my Black Sabbath. It's in there somewhere, even a bit of Sabbath.
